hypothesis: At least one of three low-complexity architectures can improve frozen V11 net CAGR by >=1.5 percentage points while preserving Sharpe >=1.40, MDD <=12%, at least 5/7 fixed folds with Sharpe >1, worst-fold Sharpe >0 and 100% gross/no-short constraints under 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage.
allowed_changes: HR-A exact multi-timescale trend allocator from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-20-high-return-research-line-design.md
HR-B exact V11 state-conditioned risk-budget completion from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-20-high-return-research-line-design.md
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path change
replacing HR-A, HR-B or HR-C after viewing results
adding HR-D or other rescue candidates inside this trial
leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
using candidate realized performance to alter another candidate
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Mechanically report ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and TARGET_REGION flags for all three preregistered candidates; V11 is a control only and not a fourth candidate.
pass_fail_gates: full-history CAGR >= frozen V11 CAGR +1.5 percentage points
at least 5/7 fixed folds have Sharpe >1.0
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
TARGET_REGION only if admitted plus CAGR >=18.0% and Sharpe >=1.45
follow_up_policy: No parameter, cadence, band, trend-window, breadth-threshold or blend-weight search is allowed after results. Any new idea is a separately preregistered trial family and all HR-A/HR-B/HR-C outcomes remain in trial accounting and future DSR/PBO accounting.
expected_outputs: V11 control full-history metrics and fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics for control and candidates
trade count and average cash ratio
target fingerprint, max gross and min target weight
mechanical ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and TARGET_REGION flags for every candidate
run authorization receipt and exact execution Git commit
